thread:
zoe: Heads-up: tenant-mapping backfill produced duplicate charges for 3 tenants in staging. Need a safe playbook for mapping fixes.
andrew: Oops. Did the backfill emit charge events or idempotency-marked events?
zoe: It emitted charge events identical to live. Finalizer had no way to tell.
sylvia: Proposal: backfills should emit 'mapping_correction' envelopes with fields referencing original_event_id and include from_tenant/to_tenant and delta_tokens. Finalizer treats these as corrections, not new charges.
andrew: Agreed. Also add a replay_id and signature so finalizer can dedupe by replay_id + correction_id.
zoe: We also want a preview run: dry-run finalizer with corrections to generate a delta report for finance.
metering-bot: created ticket PLAT-5401 for backfill correction mode + preview API :white_check_mark:
andrew: Action items: sylvia spec for correction envelope (today), zoe run staging preview and share report (tomorrow), me add finalizer dedupe (Weds).
sylvia: I'll include audit fields (proof_id, source_checksum) in the envelope so auditors can trace mappings.
zoe: Good. Keep this minimal and auditable; avoid ad-hoc deletes.
